content.comment_body: Hello, in my setup I intend to use a [product_name] base module and a [product_name] communication module. I aim to remotely access the base module via GPRS/3G from my PC using the [product_name] software to start/stop, adjust parameters, and upload programs to the base module. Is this all possible with the communication module? Is there a simple way to set this up, like a configuration assistant, or will I need to manually configure DynDNS, VPN, routers, and IP myself? Thank you.

Based on my experience, this can't be fully realized. The attached information explains what is achievable with the communication module. Edit: Only some parameter changes on the base module via VM are possible.

Thank you for your response. I was hopeful this was possible because the manual ([url]) includes a section about OpenVPN (page 97). However, it seems the VPN might not allow direct access to the base module.
Don't you think if these features were possible, it would be clearly stated in the documentation?
Indeed, thanks again for your answer!

I believe this may be achievable (although I have not tested it myself): The [product_name] manual (page 17) states you can use OpenVPN for direct communication with the base module if the gateway is set correctly. This means the communication module's IP must be configured as the base module's gateway. Additionally, the manual mentions: you can access the base module's website, use the app, and upload/download programs using [product_name] software. Note: When trying to access the base module via communication module over GPRS, some mobile service providers block incoming traffic and may charge extra to allow direct access. Since the communication module provides only OpenVPN server (not client), your device (PC, tablet, or smartphone) must act as the client and initiate the connection. You'll need the WAN IP of the communication module or a paid dyndns service, and your SIM provider must allow direct access. This process would be easier if [company_name] added OpenVPN client functionality.
Hi [user_name], I'm interested in hearing how your project turned out. Were you able to test it successfully? Thanks. Regards

Hello [user_name], regarding your requirements to start/stop, modify parameters, and upload programs to the base module: All are feasible over VPN using the communication module. As mentioned previously, you need a public IP for the communication module and your management software must run on the PC establishing the VPN. A client VPN config file can be downloaded from the communication module after server settings are set, so you don't need to be a VPN expert. Lastly, ensure the communication module's LAN IP is set as the gateway on the base module so network traffic routes correctly.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members are discussing how to remotely manage and program the [product_name] base module through the communication module over GPRS/3G using [product_name] software. Initially, responses suggested only limited remote features, but later references to technical manuals and configuration details clarified that full management—including program upload/download and control—is technically possible with the correct VPN and gateway configuration. However, the process is not beginner-friendly, as it requires understanding of network, VPN setup, and mobile service provider permissions. Users express a preference for easier out-of-the-box configuration and would like to see OpenVPN client support added to the communication module.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates easy remote access, management, and reprogramming of the base module over GPRS/3G using the communication module and [product_name] software, ideally with a configuration assistant and minimal need for manual network settings.
